summary: A large, symmetrical, four-story fortress-like structure with a central stepped dome roof and four tall, slender corner towers. The facade features distinct horizontal banding using yellow, white, and grey materials. A spaced white block perimeter surrounds the base.

shape.overall_form: central block with four corner towers

materials.name: stonebrick
materials.role: horizontal bands, tower corners, roof accents

materials.name: quartz_block
materials.role: horizontal bands, vertical pillars, perimeter markers

rebuild_hints: Start with the central footprint: a large square with chamfered corners.
Build the 4 corner towers simultaneously to ensure symmetry; they have stonebrick edges and sandstone centers.
Construct the main walls using alternating horizontal bands: sandstone (with windows), white block, sandstone, stonebrick.
The roof is a stepped dome alternating between rings of brick and stonebrick.
Place white blocks with 1-block gaps for the perimeter boundary.
uncertainties: Exact interior layout is completely unknown.
The exact material of the white and yellow blocks (could be concrete, quartz, sandstone, or end stone).
Whether the towers are hollow or solid.
